# ==============================================================================
# Dailyfix Robots.txt
# Optimized for Google Search, Googlebot, Googlebot-Image & Bingbot
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Googlebot-Image (Full access to crawled favicons, logos, and images)
User-agent: Googlebot-Image
Allow: /
Allow: /favicon.ico
Allow: /favicon-48x48.png
Allow: /favicon-96x96.png
Allow: /favicon-192x192.png
Allow: /apple-touch-icon.png
Allow: /logo.png
Allow: /dailyfix-logo.png
Allow: /dailyfix-logo.webp
Allow: /images/
Allow: /assets/

# 2. Googlebot (Main Google Search crawler)
User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /admin/*
Disallow: /cart
Disallow: /checkout
Disallow: /order-success/*
Disallow: /order-summary/*
Disallow: /debug

# 3. All other search engine crawlers (Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo, etc.)
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /admin/*
Disallow: /cart
Disallow: /checkout
Disallow: /order-success/*
Disallow: /order-summary/*
Disallow: /debug

# XML Sitemap Location
Sitemap: https://dailyfixcare.com/sitemap.xml
